evidence.notes: Confidence is medium on purpose, and the reason is the trigger, not the action. The literature is explicitly split on rain washing pollen: reviews of date-palm pollination management record a controversy, with some workers treating rain shortly after pollination as a washing agent that removes most of the applied pollen, and others not — and bunch covering is noted as reducing the exposure either way. This tree therefore raises a warning to re-time and verify, and does not assert that rain will destroy the set. What is well quantified is the opposing cost of delay, and it is the reason the actions push toward re-timing rather than waiting: fruit set is about 95% when pollen is applied on the day of spathe cracking and falls away as pollination is delayed, with the working guidance being not to delay more than 3-4 days. FAO's pollination and bunch-management chapter is the standing reference for the operation itself. Stage windows come from migration 0038's generic Egyptian calendar (spathe cracking late Feb into March); cultivar and season shift this, and the stage is editable per tenant.

# window, when date palm is hand-pollinated and the pollen is exposed.
#
# Scope note, deliberately narrow: this tree fires only during the
# `pollination` stage. It is a *timing* aid — "do not apply pollen into
# a wet forecast, and check set if rain followed a recent application" —

# when pollination is postponed more than 3-4 days past spathe cracking.
# So the recommendation is never "wait indefinitely for dry weather" —
# it is "re-time within the window, and verify set afterwards".

description_ar: ينبّه عندما تحمل توقعات 72 ساعة مطرًا أو هواءً رطبًا مستمرًا بينما القطعة في مرحلة نضج حسّاسة للرطوبة. تتدرّج الخطورة وفق ترتيب الفاو: الرطب والتمر الأكثر حساسية (تعفّن وتخمّر وحموضة وتساقط الثمار)، والكمري وأواخر الخلال معرّضان لتشقّق القشرة، بينما يهيّئ الهواء الرطب وحده خلال الخلال والرطب للإصابات الفطرية.
description_en: Warns when the 72-hour forecast carries rain or persistently humid air while the block is in a moisture-sensitive ripening stage. Severity follows FAO's stage ordering: Rutab and Tamar are the most sensitive (rot, fermentation, souring, fruit fall), Kimri and late Khalal risk skin checking and cracking, and humid air alone during Khalal and Rutab favours fungal spoilage.

tree_compiled.description_en: Warns when the 72-hour forecast carries rain or persistently humid air while the block is in a moisture-sensitive ripening stage. Severity follows FAO's stage ordering: Rutab and Tamar are the most sensitive (rot, fermentation, souring, fruit fall), Kimri and late Khalal risk skin checking and cracking, and humid air alone during Khalal and Rutab favours fungal spoilage.

citations.title: Date Palm Cultivation, Chapter IV — Climatic requirements of date palm (rain and humidity damage by ripening stage; harvest-month rainfall grading)
Quality preservation of date palm fruits at the Khalal stage — a review of current challenges, preservation methods and future trends (Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems)

evidence.notes: Stage ordering is quoted directly from FAO's date-palm climatic requirements chapter: rain at EARLY Khalal "does not seriously damage" the fruit and even washes off dust, but "can cause severe checking and cracking in the Kimri and late Khalal stages", while "Rutab and Tamar stages are the most sensitive since rain and associated humidity cause severe damage including rotting and fall-off of the fruit". At Rutab the fruit absorbs moisture and ferments and sours rather than splitting — a different failure mode, which is why that leaf talks about souring and not cracking. The same chapter grades harvest-month rainfall: under 50 mm in a month is good to average, over 50 mm in one month is average to poor, and over 50 mm in all three harvest months is very poor. Threshold caveat, stated plainly: FAO's 50 mm figure is MONTHLY and our forecast window is 72 hours, so it cannot be used directly. The 5 mm default here is an operational trigger chosen to be low, on the documented grounds that brief rain at Rutab can destroy a large share of a crop — it is not a calibrated FAO threshold, and it is a tunable parameter for that reason. The 60% humidity default is likewise operational: FAO describes humid air before and during Khalal as the driver of Blacknose and fungal spoilage without publishing a cutoff. Cultivar caveat: windows come from migration 0038's generic Egyptian soft/semi-dry calendar; dry cultivars such as Siwi ripen later and are markedly less rain-sensitive at Tamar.

outcome.text_en: No rain is forecast, but the air stays humid through the Khalal / Rutab window. Humid air alone favours the fungi that spoil ripening dates and is associated with Blacknose skin damage. Date palm needs hot, dry air through ripening; humidity without rain still costs grade.

outcome.text_ar: يُتوقّع مطر والمحصول في مرحلة الكمري أو الخلال. الماء على الثمار المتلوّنة يسبّب تشقّق القشرة واللحم تحتها، ما يخفض الدرجة حتى إن لم يتلف الثمار، وفتحات القشرة المبتلّة هي مدخل التعفّنات اللاحقة. لاحظ أن المطر في أوائل الخلال قليل الضرر نسبيًا وقد يغسل الغبار عن العذوق.
outcome.text_en: Rain is forecast while the crop is at Kimri or Khalal. Water on colouring fruit drives checking and cracking of the skin and the flesh beneath, which downgrades fruit even when it does not destroy it, and wet skin openings are the entry point for the rots that follow. Note that rain at EARLY Khalal is comparatively harmless and can even wash dust off the bunches.

Losses at this stage are the heaviest of the season and the window to act is hours, not days.

tree_yaml:
# date_palm_ripening_rain_risk_v1 — forecast rain / humid air during the
# ripening sequence, with severity keyed to the stage.
#
# Date palm is the clearest case in the catalog of a risk whose SEVERITY,
# not just its trigger, is phenological. The same 10 mm of forecast rain
# is a cosmetic nuisance at early Khalal, a skin-cracking loss at Kimri
# and late Khalal, and a crop-destroying rot-and-souring event at Rutab
# and Tamar. FAO's climatic-requirements chapter states the ordering
# explicitly, so the tree encodes it rather than emitting one flat alert.
#
# Practical consequence: the action changes with the severity. A Kimri
# warning is "expect checking, plan the grade-out". A Rutab critical is
# "cover the bunches or harvest ahead of the front" — a decision the
# grower has hours, not days, to make.

code: date_palm_ripening_rain_risk_v1
name_en: Date palm — rain / humidity risk during ripening
name_ar: نخيل البلح — خطر المطر والرطوبة أثناء النضج
description_en: >-
  Warns when the 72-hour forecast carries rain or persistently humid air
  while the block is in a moisture-sensitive ripening stage. Severity
  follows FAO's stage ordering: Rutab and Tamar are the most sensitive
  (rot, fermentation, souring, fruit fall), Kimri and late Khalal risk
  skin checking and cracking, and humid air alone during Khalal and
  Rutab favours fungal spoilage.
description_ar: >-
  ينبّه عندما تحمل توقعات 72 ساعة مطرًا أو هواءً رطبًا مستمرًا بينما
  القطعة في مرحلة نضج حسّاسة للرطوبة. تتدرّج الخطورة وفق ترتيب الفاو:
  الرطب والتمر الأكثر حساسية (تعفّن وتخمّر وحموضة وتساقط الثمار)،
  والكمري وأواخر الخلال معرّضان لتشقّق القشرة، بينما يهيّئ الهواء الرطب
  وحده خلال الخلال والرطب للإصابات الفطرية.

crop_code: date_palm
applicable_regions: []

evidence:
  confidence: high
  notes: >-
    Stage ordering is quoted directly from FAO's date-palm climatic
    requirements chapter: rain at EARLY Khalal "does not seriously
    damage" the fruit and even washes off dust, but "can cause severe
    checking and cracking in the Kimri and late Khalal stages", while
    "Rutab and Tamar stages are the most sensitive since rain and
    associated humidity cause severe damage including rotting and
    fall-off of the fruit". At Rutab the fruit absorbs moisture and
    ferments and sours rather than splitting — a different failure mode,
    which is why that leaf talks about souring and not cracking. The same
    chapter grades harvest-month rainfall: under 50 mm in a month is good
    to average, over 50 mm in one month is average to poor, and over
    50 mm in all three harvest months is very poor.
    Threshold caveat, stated plainly: FAO's 50 mm figure is MONTHLY and
    our forecast window is 72 hours, so it cannot be used directly. The
    5 mm default here is an operational trigger chosen to be low, on the
    documented grounds that brief rain at Rutab can destroy a large share
    of a crop — it is not a calibrated FAO threshold, and it is a tunable
    parameter for that reason. The 60% humidity default is likewise
    operational: FAO describes humid air before and during Khalal as the
    driver of Blacknose and fungal spoilage without publishing a cutoff.
    Cultivar caveat: windows come from migration 0038's generic Egyptian
    soft/semi-dry calendar; dry cultivars such as Siwi ripen later and
    are markedly less rain-sensitive at Tamar.
  citations:
    - source_type: fao
      title: >-
        Date Palm Cultivation, Chapter IV — Climatic requirements of date
        palm (rain and humidity damage by ripening stage; harvest-month
        rainfall grading)
      url: https://www.fao.org/4/y4360e/y4360e08.htm
    - source_type: peer_reviewed
      title: >-
        Quality preservation of date palm fruits at the Khalal stage — a
        review of current challenges, preservation methods and future
        trends (Frontiers in Sustainable Food Systems)
      url: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/sustainable-food-systems/articles/10.3389/fsufs.2025.1558985/full
      year: 2025

description_ar: يُطلق تحذيرًا عند تجاوز ملوحة عجينة التربة المُشبعة (المُدخَلة كإشارة مخصّصة باسم `soil_salinity` بوحدة dS/m) لحدّ تحمّل نخيل البلح. تصنّف FAO-29 النخيل كمتحمّل: لا استجابة للمحصول دون 4.0 dS/m، ثم نحو 3.6% فقد لكل dS/m إضافي. ويبدأ الإجهاد الحاد (فقد يتجاوز 25%) قرب 10.9.
description_en: Raises a warning when a block's soil saturated-paste ECe (ingested as the custom signal `soil_salinity`, in dS/m) exceeds date palm's salinity tolerance. FAO-29 rates date palm tolerant: no yield response below ECe 4.0 dS/m, then roughly 3.6% yield loss per additional dS/m. Severe stress (>25% expected loss) starts near ECe 10.9.

tree_compiled.description_en: Raises a warning when a block's soil saturated-paste ECe (ingested as the custom signal `soil_salinity`, in dS/m) exceeds date palm's salinity tolerance. FAO-29 rates date palm tolerant: no yield response below ECe 4.0 dS/m, then roughly 3.6% yield loss per additional dS/m. Severe stress (>25% expected loss) starts near ECe 10.9.

citations.title: Annex 1, Table A1.2 — Salt tolerance of woody crops (date palm: ECe threshold 4.0 dS/m, slope 3.6%/dS/m, rated tolerant), reproducing FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 29
Long-term growth, water consumption and yield of date palm as a function of salinity (Agricultural Water Management)
Salinity stress in date palm (Phoenix dactylifera L.): tolerance, mechanisms and mitigation — Horticulture, Environment and Biotechnology

evidence.notes: Threshold 4.0 dS/m and slope 3.6% per dS/m are the date-palm row of the FAO crop salt-tolerance table for woody crops (Table A1.2, reproducing FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 29, Maas-Hoffman), rated T for tolerant, based on fruit yield. The severe default is derived from that same linear model rather than separately measured: Yr = 100 - 3.6 x (ECe - 4.0) reaches 75% relative yield at ECe 10.9, which is the 25%-loss point used as "severe" in the potato tree, so the two crops are severity-comparable. For reference the model puts 90% yield at ECe 6.8 and 50% at ECe 17.9. Cultivar caveat, and it is a large one: cultivar variation in date palm swamps the single FAO figure. Long-term Gulf trials group varieties into distinct tolerance classes, with tolerant cultivars such as Lulu and Barhi holding 50% yield near 12 dS/m ECw and mid-range cultivars nearer 9 dS/m ECw. The FAO row is the conservative crop-wide default; tenants growing a known-tolerant cultivar should raise both parameters rather than accept warnings they will learn to ignore. Note also that those cultivar figures are ECw (irrigation water), not ECe (soil paste) — the two are not interchangeable, ECe runs roughly 1.5x ECw under typical leaching.

tree_yaml:
# date_palm_soil_salinity_v1 — soil salinity stress on date palm from a
# soil ECe custom signal.
#
# Deliberately the mirror image of potato_soil_salinity_v1, and the
# contrast is the point: date palm is rated TOLERANT with an ECe
# threshold of 4.0 dS/m, where potato is rated sensitive at 1.7. A block
# reading 3.5 dS/m is a warning for potato and a non-event for date
# palm. Sharing one salinity rule across both crops would be wrong in
# both directions, which is why salinity thresholds live per crop.
#
# Reads the same tenant custom signal (`soil_salinity`, ECe in dS/m) as
# the potato tree, so a tenant ingesting soil tests gets both crops
# covered from one feed.

code: date_palm_soil_salinity_v1
name_en: Date palm — soil salinity stress
name_ar: نخيل البلح — إجهاد ملوحة التربة
description_en: >-
  Raises a warning when a block's soil saturated-paste ECe (ingested as
  the custom signal `soil_salinity`, in dS/m) exceeds date palm's
  salinity tolerance. FAO-29 rates date palm tolerant: no yield response
  below ECe 4.0 dS/m, then roughly 3.6% yield loss per additional dS/m.
  Severe stress (>25% expected loss) starts near ECe 10.9.
description_ar: >-
  يُطلق تحذيرًا عند تجاوز ملوحة عجينة التربة المُشبعة (المُدخَلة كإشارة
  مخصّصة باسم `soil_salinity` بوحدة dS/m) لحدّ تحمّل نخيل البلح. تصنّف
  FAO-29 النخيل كمتحمّل: لا استجابة للمحصول دون 4.0 dS/m، ثم نحو 3.6%
  فقد لكل dS/m إضافي. ويبدأ الإجهاد الحاد (فقد يتجاوز 25%) قرب 10.9.

crop_code: date_palm
applicable_regions: []

evidence:
  confidence: high
  notes: >-
    Threshold 4.0 dS/m and slope 3.6% per dS/m are the date-palm row of
    the FAO crop salt-tolerance table for woody crops (Table A1.2,
    reproducing FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 29, Maas-Hoffman), rated
    T for tolerant, based on fruit yield. The severe default is derived
    from that same linear model rather than separately measured:
    Yr = 100 - 3.6 x (ECe - 4.0) reaches 75% relative yield at ECe 10.9,
    which is the 25%-loss point used as "severe" in the potato tree, so
    the two crops are severity-comparable. For reference the model puts
    90% yield at ECe 6.8 and 50% at ECe 17.9.
    Cultivar caveat, and it is a large one: cultivar variation in date
    palm swamps the single FAO figure. Long-term Gulf trials group
    varieties into distinct tolerance classes, with tolerant cultivars
    such as Lulu and Barhi holding 50% yield near 12 dS/m ECw and
    mid-range cultivars nearer 9 dS/m ECw. The FAO row is the
    conservative crop-wide default; tenants growing a known-tolerant
    cultivar should raise both parameters rather than accept warnings
    they will learn to ignore. Note also that those cultivar figures are
    ECw (irrigation water), not ECe (soil paste) — the two are not
    interchangeable, ECe runs roughly 1.5x ECw under typical leaching.
  citations:
    - source_type: fao
      title: >-
        Annex 1, Table A1.2 — Salt tolerance of woody crops (date palm:
        ECe threshold 4.0 dS/m, slope 3.6%/dS/m, rated tolerant),
        reproducing FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 29
      url: https://www.fao.org/4/y4263e/y4263e0e.htm
      year: 1985
    - source_type: peer_reviewed
      title: >-
        Long-term growth, water consumption and yield of date palm as a
        function of salinity (Agricultural Water Management)
      url: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0378377411001454
    - source_type: peer_reviewed
      title: >-
        Salinity stress in date palm (Phoenix dactylifera L.): tolerance,
        mechanisms and mitigation — Horticulture, Environment and
        Biotechnology
      doi: 10.1007/s13580-023-00511-4

tree_yaml:
# mango_canopy_health_v1 — "sudden drop -> scout" health alert that picks
# the right greenness index for the block's canopy/soil context.
#
# Standard NDVI gets noisy over sparse mango canopies with bright bare
# soil between trees (young orchards, high-density foreign varieties, sandy
# reclamation land). SAVI (soil-adjusted, L=0.5) suppresses that soil
# background. So this tree branches:
#   * sandy soil -> evaluate SAVI's baseline deviation
#   * otherwise  -> evaluate NDVI's baseline deviation
# and scouts when the chosen index drops sharply below the block's own
# day-of-year baseline (self-calibrating z-score — no absolute per-variety
# matrix needed).
#
# v4 dropped a `canopy_size_class == small` node that used to sit above the
# soil check. Nothing in the product ever set that field, so the node took its
# on_miss branch for every block that has ever been evaluated: removing it
# changes no outcome, it just stops the tree from asking a question no block
# can answer.

tree_yaml:
# ndvi_baseline_alert_v1 — alert when a block's NDVI drops below its
# seasonal baseline. Replaces the platform `default_rules` rows
# `ndvi_severe_drop` + `ndvi_warning_drop` as PR-F retires the rules
# engine and the trees engine takes over alert generation.
#
# Why one tree instead of two rules: PR-E's leaf-kind discriminator
# lets the same walk emit a *critical* or a *warning* alert based on
# the severity of the drop. The two former rules become two leaves
# under a single severity-check branch. Tenants who want to tune the
# trigger thresholds use PR-C parameter overrides on this tree
# rather than the now-retired `rule_overrides` table.
#
# This tree emits an *alert* (kind: alert). It used to pair with
# `scout_for_stress_v1`, which raised a scouting *recommendation* on the
# same signal; that tree was archived in public migration 0073 because its
# thresholds were hardcoded rather than tunable and it asked the same
# question as `mango_canopy_health_v1` on a mango block. This tree is now
# the only crop-agnostic NDVI-drop rule, and it is the alert half.

code: ndvi_baseline_alert_v1
name_en: NDVI below seasonal baseline
name_ar: انخفاض NDVI عن المعدل الموسمي
description_en: >-
  Fires an alert when a block's NDVI baseline deviation drops below
  the configured threshold. Critical when the drop is severe; warning
  when it's moderate. Successor to the retired `ndvi_severe_drop` +
  `ndvi_warning_drop` rules (PR-F sunset).
description_ar: >-
  ينطلق تنبيه عندما يهبط انحراف NDVI عن المعدل الموسمي تحت العتبة
  المحددة. حرج للانخفاض الحاد، تحذيري للمتوسط. خليفة قاعدتي
  `ndvi_severe_drop` و `ndvi_warning_drop` المنسحبتين (PR-F).

crop_code: null
applicable_regions: []

# Parameter knobs let tenants tighten or loosen the thresholds via
# PR-C without forking the tree. Defaults match the original
# `default_rules` row values so behaviour is unchanged out of the box.
parameters:
  warning_threshold:
    type: number
    default: -0.75
    min: -3.0
    max: 0.0
    description: >-
      NDVI baseline deviation below which a `warning` alert fires
      (default −0.75 σ, matching the legacy `ndvi_warning_drop` rule).
  critical_threshold:
    type: number
    default: -1.5
    min: -3.0
    max: 0.0
    description: >-
      NDVI baseline deviation below which the alert escalates to
      `critical` (default −1.5 σ, matching the legacy
      `ndvi_severe_drop` rule). Must be ≤ `warning_threshold` for
      the escalation gate to be reachable.

evidence.notes: Cultivated potato (S. tuberosum) cannot cold-acclimate; foliar injury begins near -2 °C and foliage is killed near -3 °C. The kill point is ice-nucleation dependent — unnucleated leaves can supercool to -6/-8 °C — so this is a risk flag, not a certainty. Frost is less frequent in core Egyptian production but occurs in winter plantings and inland/desert sites, hence medium Egypt applicability.

description_ar: يقارن قراءة نترات النيتروجين في عصارة عنق الورقة (الإشارة المخصّصة `petiole_no3n`، عصارة طازجة بوحدة ppm) بنطاق الكفاية الخاص بمرحلة نمو القطعة الحالية. ينبّه إلى النقص خلال النمو الخضري/بداية التدرين (أقل من 1200 ppm) وامتلاء الدرنات (أقل من 800 ppm) حيث يظل التسميد النيتروجيني مُجديًا، كما ينبّه إلى بقاء النترات مرتفعة عند النضج مما يؤخّر النضج وتكوّن القشرة. يبقى صامتًا حتى تُدخَل نتيجة تحليل.
description_en: Compares a block's petiole sap nitrate-N reading (custom signal `petiole_no3n`, fresh sap in ppm) against the sufficiency band for the block's *current growth stage*. Flags deficiency during vegetative / tuberization (<1200 ppm) and tuber bulking (<800 ppm), when supplemental nitrogen still pays, and flags nitrate still running high at maturation, which delays maturity and skin set. Stays silent until a petiole test is ingested.

tree_compiled.description_en: Compares a block's petiole sap nitrate-N reading (custom signal `petiole_no3n`, fresh sap in ppm) against the sufficiency band for the block's *current growth stage*. Flags deficiency during vegetative / tuberization (<1200 ppm) and tuber bulking (<800 ppm), when supplemental nitrogen still pays, and flags nitrate still running high at maturation, which delays maturity and skin set. Stays silent until a petiole test is ingested.

citations.title: Potato fertilization on irrigated soils — University of Minnesota Extension (petiole sap nitrate-N by growth stage, Russet Burbank)
Fertilizing Potato in North Dakota — NDSU Extension, Table 8 (Russet Burbank petiole sap nitrate) and Table 7 (dry-weight petiole sufficiency)
Understanding plant analysis for crops — University of Minnesota Extension (petiole sampling position and interpretation)

evidence.notes: Sufficiency bands are the Russet Burbank petiole SAP nitrate-N ranges published by two independent land-grant extension services that agree to the digit: vegetative/tuberization 1200-1600 ppm, tuber growth/bulking 800-1100 ppm, bulking/maturation 400-700 ppm. The tree tests the LOWER bound of each band. Cultivar caveat: these are Russet Burbank values and other cultivars differ — NDSU and UMN both say so explicitly — hence every bound is a tunable parameter. Basis caveat: these are fresh-sap readings; the dry-weight petiole equivalents for the same stages are 1.7-2.2% / 1.1-1.5% / 0.6-0.9% NO3-N, ~10x larger in ppm terms, and the two are routinely confused in secondary sources. No Egypt-specific primary petiole thresholds were found, so Egypt applicability is inherited from irrigated temperate/arid data — the sampling protocol (4th petiole from the tip, 30-50 plants) transfers, the absolute band may need local calibration. Stage mapping: our `vegetative` and `tuber_initiation` both fall inside extension's "vegetative/tuberization" window.

early_check.label_en: Is sap nitrate below the vegetative/tuberization band?

leaf_deficient_bulking.label_ar: نقص نيتروجين خلال امتلاء الدرنات — عوّض

immediate.text_ar: طبّق جرعة نيتروجين معتدلة عبر الريّ بحجم يسدّ الفجوة، لا ليرفع القراءة إلى أعلى النطاق.
immediate.text_en: Apply a modest fertigated nitrogen dose sized to close the gap, not to push the reading to the top of the band.

monitoring.text_ar: تابع الاتجاه الأسبوعي — يجب أن تنخفض النترات تدريجيًا نحو نطاق النضج 400-700 ppm.
monitoring.text_en: Track the weekly trend — nitrate should decline steadily toward the 400-700 ppm maturation band.

short_term.text_ar: أعد أخذ عيّنة الأعناق خلال 7 أيام لتأكيد التعافي.
short_term.text_en: Re-sample petioles in 7 days to confirm recovery.

outcome.text_ar: نترات عصارة العنق أقل من نطاق 800-1100 ppm لمرحلة امتلاء الدرنات. هذه المرحلة هي نافذة تراكم المحصول الرئيسية، فعالج النقص — مع إبقاء الجرعة معتدلة لأن النترات يجب أن تنخفض إلى نطاق النضج في موعدها.
outcome.text_en: Petiole sap nitrate is below the 800-1100 ppm band for tuber bulking. Bulking is the main yield-accumulation window, so correct the shortfall — but keep the application modest, since nitrate must still decline into the maturation band on schedule.

leaf_deficient_early.label_ar: نقص نيتروجين في النمو الخضري/بداية التدرين — عوّض الآن
leaf_deficient_early.label_en: Nitrogen deficient in vegetative/tuberization — supplement now

immediate.text_ar: طبّق نيتروجينًا تكميليًا عبر الريّ بالتسميد؛ الجرعات المُجزّأة تواكب المحصول أفضل من جرعة واحدة.
immediate.text_en: Apply supplemental nitrogen through fertigation; split applications track the crop better than a single dose.

long_term.text_ar: راجع الموازنة النيتروجينية للموسم وتحليل التربة قبل الزراعة مقابل الامتصاص الفعلي.
long_term.text_en: Review the season's nitrogen budget and pre-plant soil test against actual uptake.

monitoring.text_ar: خذ عيّنة من العنق الرابع من قمة النبات، 30-50 نباتًا لكل حقل، أسبوعيًا حتى امتلاء الدرنات.
monitoring.text_en: Sample the 4th petiole from the shoot tip, 30-50 plants per field, weekly through bulking.

short_term.text_ar: أعد أخذ عيّنة أعناق بعد 7 أيام من التطبيق للتأكد من عودة القراءة إلى النطاق.
short_term.text_en: Re-sample petioles 7 days after the application to confirm the reading has moved back into band.

short_term.text_ar: تأكّد أن الريّ لا يغسل النترات أسفل منطقة الجذور قبل إضافة مزيد من السماد.
short_term.text_en: Check that irrigation is not leaching nitrate below the root zone before adding more fertilizer.

outcome.text_ar: نترات عصارة عنق الورقة أقل من نطاق الكفاية 1200-1600 ppm للنمو الخضري/بداية التدرين. في هذه المرحلة يرتبط قياس النترات بأعلى درجة بالمحصول النهائي، لذا فإن النقص الآن هو الأكثر كلفةً عند تجاهله والأسهل تداركًا.
outcome.text_en: Petiole sap nitrate is below the 1200-1600 ppm sufficiency band for vegetative / tuber initiation. This is the stage where petiole nitrate correlates best with final yield, so a shortfall now is the most costly one to ignore — and the most correctable.

leaf_excess_maturation.label_ar: النترات ما زالت مرتفعة عند النضج — النضج في خطر
leaf_excess_maturation.label_en: Nitrate still high at maturation — maturity at risk

immediate.text_ar: أوقف كل إضافات النيتروجين على هذه القطعة.
immediate.text_en: Stop all further nitrogen applications on this block.

long_term.text_ar: قلّل نيتروجين آخر الموسم في خطة الموسم القادم؛ الخلل في التوقيت لا في الكمية الإجمالية.
long_term.text_en: Reduce late-season nitrogen in next season's plan; the shortfall is in timing, not total rate.

monitoring.text_ar: أعد أخذ العيّنة أسبوعيًا وتأكّد من انخفاض النترات قبل الحصاد.
monitoring.text_en: Re-sample weekly and confirm nitrate is falling before harvest.

short_term.text_ar: خطّط لتجفيف العروش/إزالتها لفرض تكوّن القشرة قبل الحصاد.
short_term.text_en: Plan vine desiccation / haulm destruction to force skin set before harvest.

outcome.text_ar: نترات عصارة العنق ما زالت أعلى من نطاق النضج. بقاء النيتروجين مرتفعًا في هذا الوقت المتأخر يبقي المجموع الخضري أخضر ويؤخّر نضج الدرنات وتكوّن القشرة، ويرفع خطر الكدمات وفواقد التخزين عند الحصاد. أوقف النيتروجين ودع المحصول ينضج.
outcome.text_en: Petiole sap nitrate is still above the maturation band. Nitrogen that stays high this late keeps the canopy green, delays tuber maturity and skin set, and raises the risk of bruising and storage losses at harvest. Stop nitrogen and let the crop mature.

tree_yaml:
# potato_petiole_nitrogen_v1 — stage-gated petiole sap nitrate-N status
# for potato.
#
# This is the first tree in the catalog whose thresholds are *phenology
# dependent* rather than absolute: the sufficiency band for petiole
# nitrate falls by roughly two thirds between tuberization and
# maturation, so a single cutoff would either over-fertilize late or
# miss a genuine early deficiency. It is only expressible because the
# phenology spine now resolves `block.growth_stage` from the crop
# taxonomy (see migration 0033 for the potato stage vocabulary).
#
# UNITS MATTER: the thresholds below are FRESH SAP nitrate-N in ppm
# (the Cardy/LAQUA-Twin sap-meter reading). They are NOT the dry-weight
# petiole values, which run ~1.7-2.2% NO3-N over the same stages — an
# order of magnitude apart. A tenant ingesting dry-weight numbers into
# this signal would see the tree fire constantly. The signal
# description must state "fresh sap, ppm".

code: potato_petiole_nitrogen_v1
name_en: Potato — petiole sap nitrate (stage-gated)
name_ar: البطاطس — نترات عنق الورقة (حسب مرحلة النمو)
description_en: >-
  Compares a block's petiole sap nitrate-N reading (custom signal
  `petiole_no3n`, fresh sap in ppm) against the sufficiency band for the
  block's *current growth stage*. Flags deficiency during vegetative /
  tuberization (<1200 ppm) and tuber bulking (<800 ppm), when
  supplemental nitrogen still pays, and flags nitrate still running high
  at maturation, which delays maturity and skin set. Stays silent until
  a petiole test is ingested.
description_ar: >-
  يقارن قراءة نترات النيتروجين في عصارة عنق الورقة (الإشارة المخصّصة
  `petiole_no3n`، عصارة طازجة بوحدة ppm) بنطاق الكفاية الخاص بمرحلة نمو
  القطعة الحالية. ينبّه إلى النقص خلال النمو الخضري/بداية التدرين
  (أقل من 1200 ppm) وامتلاء الدرنات (أقل من 800 ppm) حيث يظل التسميد
  النيتروجيني مُجديًا، كما ينبّه إلى بقاء النترات مرتفعة عند النضج مما
  يؤخّر النضج وتكوّن القشرة. يبقى صامتًا حتى تُدخَل نتيجة تحليل.

crop_code: potato
applicable_regions: []

evidence:
  confidence: high
  notes: >-
    Sufficiency bands are the Russet Burbank petiole SAP nitrate-N
    ranges published by two independent land-grant extension services
    that agree to the digit: vegetative/tuberization 1200-1600 ppm,
    tuber growth/bulking 800-1100 ppm, bulking/maturation 400-700 ppm.
    The tree tests the LOWER bound of each band. Cultivar caveat: these
    are Russet Burbank values and other cultivars differ — NDSU and UMN
    both say so explicitly — hence every bound is a tunable parameter.
    Basis caveat: these are fresh-sap readings; the dry-weight petiole
    equivalents for the same stages are 1.7-2.2% / 1.1-1.5% / 0.6-0.9%
    NO3-N, ~10x larger in ppm terms, and the two are routinely confused
    in secondary sources. No Egypt-specific primary petiole thresholds
    were found, so Egypt applicability is inherited from irrigated
    temperate/arid data — the sampling protocol (4th petiole from the
    tip, 30-50 plants) transfers, the absolute band may need local
    calibration. Stage mapping: our `vegetative` and `tuber_initiation`
    both fall inside extension's "vegetative/tuberization" window.
  citations:
    - source_type: extension
      title: >-
        Potato fertilization on irrigated soils — University of
        Minnesota Extension (petiole sap nitrate-N by growth stage,
        Russet Burbank)
      url: https://extension.umn.edu/crop-specific-needs/potato-fertilization-irrigated-soils
    - source_type: extension
      title: >-
        Fertilizing Potato in North Dakota — NDSU Extension, Table 8
        (Russet Burbank petiole sap nitrate) and Table 7 (dry-weight
        petiole sufficiency)
      url: https://www.ndsu.edu/agriculture/extension/publications/fertilizing-potato-north-dakota
    - source_type: extension
      title: >-
        Understanding plant analysis for crops — University of Minnesota
        Extension (petiole sampling position and interpretation)
      url: https://extension.umn.edu/testing-and-analysis/understanding-plant-analysis-crops

transferability:
  egypt: medium
  middle_east: medium
  global: high

parameters:
  sufficient_early:
    type: number
    default: 1200
    min: 0
    max: 5000
    description: >-
      Petiole sap NO3-N (ppm) below which the block is nitrogen
      deficient during vegetative / tuber initiation. Lower bound of the
      1200-1600 ppm band.
  sufficient_bulking:
    type: number
    default: 800
    min: 0
    max: 5000
    description: >-
      Petiole sap NO3-N (ppm) below which the block is deficient during
      tuber bulking. Lower bound of the 800-1100 ppm band.
  sufficient_maturation:
    type: number
    default: 400
    min: 0
    max: 5000
    description: >-
      Petiole sap NO3-N (ppm) below which nitrate has fallen under the
      maturation band (400-700 ppm).
  excess_maturation:
    type: number
    default: 1100
    min: 0
    max: 10000
    description: >-
      Petiole sap NO3-N (ppm) above which nitrate is still running high
      at maturation, delaying maturity and skin set.

root: root
nodes:
  root:
    label_en: Is the block in a stage where petiole nitrate is interpretable?
    label_ar: هل القطعة في مرحلة يمكن فيها تفسير نترات عنق الورقة؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: in
        left:
          source: block
          field: growth_stage
        values: [vegetative, tuber_initiation, tuber_bulking, maturation]
    on_match: data_check
    on_miss: leaf_out_of_window

  # Presence probe. A missing signal resolves to None and every
  # comparison short-circuits to False, which would otherwise walk to
  # the "sufficient" leaf and read as false reassurance. Sap nitrate is
  # strictly positive, so `> 0` separates "no test on record" from a
  # genuine low reading.
  data_check:
    label_en: Is there a petiole sap nitrate reading for this block?
    label_ar: هل توجد قراءة نترات لعصارة عنق الورقة لهذه القطعة؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: gt
        left:
          source: signals
          code: petiole_no3n
          key: value_numeric
        right: 0
    on_match: stage_early
    on_miss: leaf_no_data

  stage_early:
    label_en: Is the block in vegetative or tuber initiation?
    label_ar: هل القطعة في النمو الخضري أو بداية التدرين؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: in
        left:
          source: block
          field: growth_stage
        values: [vegetative, tuber_initiation]
    on_match: early_check
    on_miss: stage_bulking

  early_check:
    label_en: Is sap nitrate below the vegetative/tuberization band?
    label_ar: هل النترات أقل من نطاق النمو الخضري/بداية التدرين؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: lt
        left:
          source: signals
          code: petiole_no3n
          key: value_numeric
        right:
          source: params
          name: sufficient_early
    on_match: leaf_deficient_early
    on_miss: leaf_sufficient

  stage_bulking:
    label_en: Is the block in tuber bulking?
    label_ar: هل القطعة في مرحلة امتلاء الدرنات؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: eq
        left:
          source: block
          field: growth_stage
        right: tuber_bulking
    on_match: bulking_check
    on_miss: maturation_excess_check

  bulking_check:
    label_en: Is sap nitrate below the tuber-bulking band?
    label_ar: هل النترات أقل من نطاق امتلاء الدرنات؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: lt
        left:
          source: signals
          code: petiole_no3n
          key: value_numeric
        right:
          source: params
          name: sufficient_bulking
    on_match: leaf_deficient_bulking
    on_miss: leaf_sufficient

  maturation_excess_check:
    label_en: Is sap nitrate still high at maturation?
    label_ar: هل النترات ما زالت مرتفعة عند النضج؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: gt
        left:
          source: signals
          code: petiole_no3n
          key: value_numeric
        right:
          source: params
          name: excess_maturation
    on_match: leaf_excess_maturation
    on_miss: maturation_low_check

  maturation_low_check:
    label_en: Has sap nitrate fallen below the maturation band?
    label_ar: هل انخفضت النترات دون نطاق النضج؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: lt
        left:
          source: signals
          code: petiole_no3n
          key: value_numeric
        right:
          source: params
          name: sufficient_maturation
    on_match: leaf_low_maturation
    on_miss: leaf_sufficient

  # ---- leaves -------------------------------------------------------

  leaf_deficient_early:
    label_en: Nitrogen deficient in vegetative/tuberization — supplement now
    label_ar: نقص نيتروجين في النمو الخضري/بداية التدرين — عوّض الآن
    outcome:
      kind: recommendation
      action_type: fertilize
      severity: warning
      confidence: 0.8
      valid_for_hours: 168
      parameters:
        priority: high
        stage_band: vegetative_tuberization
      text_en: >-
        Petiole sap nitrate is below the 1200-1600 ppm sufficiency band
        for vegetative / tuber initiation. This is the stage where
        petiole nitrate correlates best with final yield, so a shortfall
        now is the most costly one to ignore — and the most correctable.
      text_ar: >-
        نترات عصارة عنق الورقة أقل من نطاق الكفاية 1200-1600 ppm للنمو
        الخضري/بداية التدرين. في هذه المرحلة يرتبط قياس النترات بأعلى
        درجة بالمحصول النهائي، لذا فإن النقص الآن هو الأكثر كلفةً عند
        تجاهله والأسهل تداركًا.
      actions:
        immediate:
          - text_en: >-
              Apply supplemental nitrogen through fertigation; split
              applications track the crop better than a single dose.
            text_ar: >-
              طبّق نيتروجينًا تكميليًا عبر الريّ بالتسميد؛ الجرعات
              المُجزّأة تواكب المحصول أفضل من جرعة واحدة.
        short_term:
          - text_en: >-
              Re-sample petioles 7 days after the application to confirm
              the reading has moved back into band.
            text_ar: >-
              أعد أخذ عيّنة أعناق بعد 7 أيام من التطبيق للتأكد من عودة
              القراءة إلى النطاق.
          - text_en: >-
              Check that irrigation is not leaching nitrate below the
              root zone before adding more fertilizer.
            text_ar: >-
              تأكّد أن الريّ لا يغسل النترات أسفل منطقة الجذور قبل
              إضافة مزيد من السماد.
        long_term:
          - text_en: >-
              Review the season's nitrogen budget and pre-plant soil
              test against actual uptake.
            text_ar: >-
              راجع الموازنة النيتروجينية للموسم وتحليل التربة قبل
              الزراعة مقابل الامتصاص الفعلي.
        monitoring:
          - text_en: >-
              Sample the 4th petiole from the shoot tip, 30-50 plants
              per field, weekly through bulking.
            text_ar: >-
              خذ عيّنة من العنق الرابع من قمة النبات، 30-50 نباتًا لكل
              حقل، أسبوعيًا حتى امتلاء الدرنات.

  leaf_deficient_bulking:
    label_en: Nitrogen deficient during bulking — supplement
    label_ar: نقص نيتروجين خلال امتلاء الدرنات — عوّض
    outcome:
      kind: recommendation
      action_type: fertilize
      severity: warning
      confidence: 0.75
      valid_for_hours: 168
      parameters:
        priority: medium
        stage_band: tuber_bulking
      text_en: >-
        Petiole sap nitrate is below the 800-1100 ppm band for tuber
        bulking. Bulking is the main yield-accumulation window, so
        correct the shortfall — but keep the application modest, since
        nitrate must still decline into the maturation band on schedule.
      text_ar: >-
        نترات عصارة العنق أقل من نطاق 800-1100 ppm لمرحلة امتلاء
        الدرنات. هذه المرحلة هي نافذة تراكم المحصول الرئيسية، فعالج
        النقص — مع إبقاء الجرعة معتدلة لأن النترات يجب أن تنخفض إلى
        نطاق النضج في موعدها.
      actions:
        immediate:
          - text_en: >-
              Apply a modest fertigated nitrogen dose sized to close the
              gap, not to push the reading to the top of the band.
            text_ar: >-
              طبّق جرعة نيتروجين معتدلة عبر الريّ بحجم يسدّ الفجوة، لا
              ليرفع القراءة إلى أعلى النطاق.
        short_term:
          - text_en: Re-sample petioles in 7 days to confirm recovery.
            text_ar: أعد أخذ عيّنة الأعناق خلال 7 أيام لتأكيد التعافي.
        monitoring:
          - text_en: >-
              Track the weekly trend — nitrate should decline steadily
              toward the 400-700 ppm maturation band.
            text_ar: >-
              تابع الاتجاه الأسبوعي — يجب أن تنخفض النترات تدريجيًا نحو
              نطاق النضج 400-700 ppm.

  leaf_excess_maturation:
    label_en: Nitrate still high at maturation — maturity at risk
    label_ar: النترات ما زالت مرتفعة عند النضج — النضج في خطر
    outcome:
      kind: recommendation
      action_type: other
      severity: warning
      confidence: 0.7
      valid_for_hours: 168
      parameters:
        priority: medium
        stage_band: maturation
      text_en: >-
        Petiole sap nitrate is still above the maturation band. Nitrogen
        that stays high this late keeps the canopy green, delays tuber
        maturity and skin set, and raises the risk of bruising and
        storage losses at harvest. Stop nitrogen and let the crop mature.
      text_ar: >-
        نترات عصارة العنق ما زالت أعلى من نطاق النضج. بقاء النيتروجين
        مرتفعًا في هذا الوقت المتأخر يبقي المجموع الخضري أخضر ويؤخّر نضج
        الدرنات وتكوّن القشرة، ويرفع خطر الكدمات وفواقد التخزين عند
        الحصاد. أوقف النيتروجين ودع المحصول ينضج.
      actions:
        immediate:
          - text_en: Stop all further nitrogen applications on this block.
            text_ar: أوقف كل إضافات النيتروجين على هذه القطعة.
        short_term:
          - text_en: >-
              Plan vine desiccation / haulm destruction to force skin
              set before harvest.
            text_ar: >-
              خطّط لتجفيف العروش/إزالتها لفرض تكوّن القشرة قبل الحصاد.
        long_term:
          - text_en: >-
              Reduce late-season nitrogen in next season's plan; the
              shortfall is in timing, not total rate.
            text_ar: >-
              قلّل نيتروجين آخر الموسم في خطة الموسم القادم؛ الخلل في
              التوقيت لا في الكمية الإجمالية.
        monitoring:
          - text_en: Re-sample weekly and confirm nitrate is falling before harvest.
            text_ar: أعد أخذ العيّنة أسبوعيًا وتأكّد من انخفاض النترات قبل الحصاد.

  leaf_low_maturation:
    label_en: Nitrate below the maturation band — expected, verify senescence
    label_ar: النترات دون نطاق النضج — متوقّع، تحقّق من الشيخوخة
    outcome:
      kind: recommendation
      action_type: other
      severity: info
      confidence: 0.6
      valid_for_hours: 336
      parameters:
        priority: low
        stage_band: maturation
      text_en: >-
        Petiole sap nitrate has fallen below the 400-700 ppm maturation
        band. Late-season decline is normal and desirable; no nitrogen
        is recommended this close to harvest. Confirm the canopy is
        senescing on schedule rather than dying prematurely.
      text_ar: >-
        انخفضت نترات عصارة العنق دون نطاق النضج 400-700 ppm. الانخفاض في
        آخر الموسم طبيعي ومرغوب؛ ولا يُنصح بالنيتروجين قرب الحصاد. تأكّد
        أن المجموع الخضري يشيخ في موعده لا أنه يموت مبكرًا.
      actions:
        monitoring:
          - text_en: >-
              Confirm senescence is on schedule; premature dieback
              points at water, disease or root damage, not nitrogen.
            text_ar: >-
              تأكّد أن الشيخوخة في موعدها؛ الموت المبكر يشير إلى الماء
              أو المرض أو ضرر الجذور لا إلى النيتروجين.

  leaf_sufficient:
    label_en: Good — petiole nitrate within the stage band
    label_ar: جيد — النترات ضمن نطاق المرحلة
    outcome:
      kind: status
      status: good
      parameters: {}
      text_en: >-
        Petiole sap nitrate is within the sufficiency band for the
        block's current growth stage.
      text_ar: >-
        نترات عصارة عنق الورقة ضمن نطاق الكفاية لمرحلة نمو القطعة
        الحالية.

  leaf_no_data:
    label_en: Not applicable — no petiole test on record
    label_ar: لا ينطبق — لا يوجد تحليل أعناق مسجّل
    outcome:
      kind: status
      status: na
      parameters: {}
      text_en: >-
        No petiole sap nitrate reading has been ingested for this block,
        so nitrogen status is unknown — this is not a statement that
        nitrogen is adequate.
      text_ar: >-
        لم تُدخَل أي قراءة لنترات عصارة عنق الورقة لهذه القطعة، لذا فحالة
        النيتروجين غير معروفة — وهذا ليس تأكيدًا بأن النيتروجين كافٍ.

  leaf_out_of_window:
    label_en: Not applicable — outside the interpretable stage window
    label_ar: لا ينطبق — خارج نافذة المراحل القابلة للتفسير
    outcome:
      kind: status
      status: na
      parameters: {}
      text_en: >-
        The block is at emergence or has no resolved growth stage.
        Petiole sampling starts once the canopy can supply a 4th leaf.
      text_ar: >-
        القطعة في مرحلة الإنبات أو ليس لها مرحلة نمو محدّدة. يبدأ أخذ
        عيّنات الأعناق عندما يوفّر المجموع الخضري ورقة رابعة.

description_en: Flags petiole phosphorus below the 0.22-0.40% (dry weight) sufficiency range during tuber initiation and bulking, when P drives tuber set and starch accumulation. Reads the custom signal `petiole_p`. Silent outside that stage window and until a test is ingested.

evidence.notes: The 0.22-0.40% petiole P sufficiency range is published by NDSU (Table 7) and University of Minnesota Extension, both quoting it at the TUBER BULKING stage. Neither gives a stage-by-stage series for P the way both do for nitrate, so this tree deliberately refuses to interpret P outside tuber initiation / bulking rather than invent a band. Evidence confidence is medium rather than high for two reasons: the range is single-stage, and petiole P is a weaker diagnostic than petiole nitrate because soil-test P and banded starter placement dominate potato P response. Treat a low reading as a prompt to check soil test P and starter placement, not as a standalone fertigation trigger. No Egypt-specific primary petiole P threshold was found; Egyptian calcareous, high-pH soils fix P more strongly than the temperate soils behind these numbers, which is why Egypt transferability is scored low.

# indistinguishable from a real one once it is in the catalog.

description_ar: ينبّه عند انخفاض بوتاسيوم عنق الورقة دون نطاق الكفاية 8.0-10.0% (وزن جاف) خلال بداية التدرين وامتلاء الدرنات. البطاطس محصول شره للبوتاسيوم وذروة الطلب في مرحلة الامتلاء، لذا يكلّف النقص هنا المحصول وجودة الدرنات معًا. يقرأ الإشارة المخصّصة `petiole_k`. يبقى صامتًا خارج تلك النافذة وحتى تُدخَل نتيجة تحليل.
description_en: Flags petiole potassium below the 8.0-10.0% (dry weight) sufficiency range during tuber initiation and bulking. Potato is a heavy potassium feeder and bulking is peak K demand, so a shortfall here costs both yield and tuber quality. Reads the custom signal `petiole_k`. Silent outside that stage window and until a test is ingested.

Potato is a heavy potassium feeder and bulking is peak K demand, so a shortfall here costs both yield and tuber quality. Reads the custom signal `petiole_k`. citations.title: Fertilizing Potato in North Dakota — NDSU Extension, Table 7 (petiole nutrient sufficiency at tuber bulking)
Potato fertilization on irrigated soils — University of Minnesota Extension

evidence.notes: The 8.0-10.0% petiole K sufficiency range is published by NDSU (Table 7) and University of Minnesota Extension, both quoting it at the TUBER BULKING stage. As with phosphorus, neither source gives a declining stage series for K, so this tree does not interpret K outside tuber initiation / bulking. Evidence confidence is medium because the band is single-stage and because petiole K is sensitive to sampling position and time of day. Chloride caveat that matters in practice: potassium chloride is the cheapest K source but raises root-zone salinity and can depress tuber specific gravity, so on saline or marginal-water blocks potassium sulfate is preferred — cross-check potato_soil_salinity_v1 before acting on this recommendation. No Egypt-specific primary petiole K threshold was found.

name_ar: البطاطس — كفاية البوتاسيوم في عنق الورقة
description_en: >-
  Flags petiole potassium below the 8.0-10.0% (dry weight) sufficiency
  range during tuber initiation and bulking. Potato is a heavy potassium
  feeder and bulking is peak K demand, so a shortfall here costs both
  yield and tuber quality. Reads the custom signal `petiole_k`. Silent
  outside that stage window and until a test is ingested.
description_ar: >-
  ينبّه عند انخفاض بوتاسيوم عنق الورقة دون نطاق الكفاية 8.0-10.0% (وزن
  جاف) خلال بداية التدرين وامتلاء الدرنات. البطاطس محصول شره
  للبوتاسيوم وذروة الطلب في مرحلة الامتلاء، لذا يكلّف النقص هنا المحصول
  وجودة الدرنات معًا. يقرأ الإشارة المخصّصة `petiole_k`. يبقى صامتًا
  خارج تلك النافذة وحتى تُدخَل نتيجة تحليل.

crop_code: potato
applicable_regions: []

evidence:
  confidence: medium
  notes: >-
    The 8.0-10.0% petiole K sufficiency range is published by NDSU
    (Table 7) and University of Minnesota Extension, both quoting it at
    the TUBER BULKING stage. As with phosphorus, neither source gives a
    declining stage series for K, so this tree does not interpret K
    outside tuber initiation / bulking. Evidence confidence is medium
    because the band is single-stage and because petiole K is sensitive
    to sampling position and time of day. Chloride caveat that matters
    in practice: potassium chloride is the cheapest K source but raises
    root-zone salinity and can depress tuber specific gravity, so on
    saline or marginal-water blocks potassium sulfate is preferred —
    cross-check potato_soil_salinity_v1 before acting on this
    recommendation. No Egypt-specific primary petiole K threshold was
    found.
  citations:
    - source_type: extension
      title: >-
        Fertilizing Potato in North Dakota — NDSU Extension, Table 7
        (petiole nutrient sufficiency at tuber bulking)
      url: https://www.ndsu.edu/agriculture/extension/publications/fertilizing-potato-north-dakota
    - source_type: extension
      title: >-
        Potato fertilization on irrigated soils — University of
        Minnesota Extension
      url: https://extension.umn.edu/crop-specific-needs/potato-fertilization-irrigated-soils

transferability:
  egypt: medium
  middle_east: medium
  global: high

parameters:
  sufficient_k:
    type: number
    default: 8.0
    min: 0.0
    max: 30.0
    description: >-
      Petiole potassium (% dry weight) below which the block is
      deficient during tuber initiation / bulking. Lower bound of the
      8.0-10.0% range.

root: root
nodes:
  root:
    label_en: Is the block in tuber initiation or bulking?
    label_ar: هل القطعة في بداية التدرين أو امتلاء الدرنات؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: in
        left:
          source: block
          field: growth_stage
        values: [tuber_initiation, tuber_bulking]
    on_match: data_check
    on_miss: leaf_out_of_window

  data_check:
    label_en: Is there a petiole potassium reading for this block?
    label_ar: هل توجد قراءة بوتاسيوم لعنق الورقة لهذه القطعة؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: gt
        left:
          source: signals
          code: petiole_k
          key: value_numeric
        right: 0
    on_match: k_check
    on_miss: leaf_no_data

  k_check:
    label_en: Is petiole potassium below the sufficiency range?
    label_ar: هل البوتاسيوم أقل من نطاق الكفاية؟
    condition:
      tree:
        op: lt
        left:
          source: signals
          code: petiole_k
          key: value_numeric
        right:
          source: params
          name: sufficient_k
    on_match: leaf_deficient
    on_miss: leaf_sufficient

  leaf_deficient:
    label_en: Petiole potassium below sufficiency — supplement K
    label_ar: بوتاسيوم العنق دون الكفاية — عوّض البوتاسيوم
    outcome:
      kind: recommendation
      action_type: fertilize
      severity: warning
      confidence: 0.7
      valid_for_hours: 336
      parameters:
        priority: medium
      text_en: >-
        Petiole potassium is below the 8.0-10.0% sufficiency range
        during peak demand. Potassium drives tuber bulking and quality —
        a shortfall now shows up as reduced size grade and lower
        specific gravity. Choose the K source with the block's salinity
        in mind: potassium sulfate on saline or marginal-water blocks,
        potassium chloride only where salinity is comfortable.
      text_ar: >-
        بوتاسيوم عنق الورقة أقل من نطاق الكفاية 8.0-10.0% في ذروة
        الطلب. يقود البوتاسيوم امتلاء الدرنات وجودتها — ويظهر النقص الآن
        في تراجع درجة الحجم وانخفاض الوزن النوعي. اختر مصدر البوتاسيوم
        بحسب ملوحة القطعة: سلفات البوتاسيوم في القطع المالحة أو ذات
        المياه الحديّة، وكلوريد البوتاسيوم فقط حيث الملوحة مريحة.
      actions:
        immediate:
          - text_en: >-
              Apply potassium through fertigation, split across the
              remaining bulking irrigations.
            text_ar: >-
              طبّق البوتاسيوم عبر الريّ بالتسميد، مُجزّأً على ريّات
              الامتلاء المتبقية.
          - text_en: >-
              Check the block's salinity status before choosing
              potassium chloride over potassium sulfate.
            text_ar: >-
              تحقّق من حالة ملوحة القطعة قبل تفضيل كلوريد البوتاسيوم على
              سلفاته.
        short_term:
          - text_en: Re-sample petioles in 7-10 days to confirm recovery.
            text_ar: أعد أخذ عيّنة الأعناق خلال 7-10 أيام لتأكيد التعافي.
        long_term:
          - text_en: >-
              Raise the pre-plant potassium rate next season; potato
              removes large amounts of K at harvest.
            text_ar: >-
              ارفع معدل البوتاسيوم قبل الزراعة في الموسم القادم؛ تسحب
              البطاطس كميات كبيرة من البوتاسيوم عند الحصاد.
        monitoring:
          - text_en: >-
              Track petiole K weekly through bulking and record tuber
              specific gravity at harvest.
            text_ar: >-
              تابع بوتاسيوم الأعناق أسبوعيًا حتى نهاية الامتلاء وسجّل
              الوزن النوعي للدرنات عند الحصاد.

  leaf_sufficient:
    label_en: Good — petiole potassium within range
    label_ar: جيد — البوتاسيوم ضمن النطاق
    outcome:
      kind: status
      status: good
      parameters: {}
      text_en: Petiole potassium is within the 8.0-10.0% sufficiency range.
      text_ar: بوتاسيوم عنق الورقة ضمن نطاق الكفاية 8.0-10.0%.

  leaf_no_data:
    label_en: Not applicable — no petiole test on record
    label_ar: لا ينطبق — لا يوجد تحليل أعناق مسجّل
    outcome:
      kind: status
      status: na
      parameters: {}
      text_en: >-
        No petiole potassium reading has been ingested for this block,
        so potassium status is unknown.
      text_ar: >-
        لم تُدخَل أي قراءة لبوتاسيوم عنق الورقة لهذه القطعة، لذا فحالة
        البوتاسيوم غير معروفة.

  leaf_out_of_window:
    label_en: Not applicable — outside the calibrated stage window
    label_ar: لا ينطبق — خارج نافذة المرحلة المعايَرة
    outcome:
      kind: status
      status: na
      parameters: {}
      text_en: >-
        The published petiole potassium range is defined for tuber
        initiation / bulking only; outside that window it is not
        interpreted.
      text_ar: >-
        نطاق بوتاسيوم عنق الورقة المنشور مُعرَّف لبداية التدرين/امتلاء
        الدرنات فقط؛ ولا يُفسَّر خارج تلك النافذة.

description_ar: يُطلق تنبيهًا تحذيريًا/حرجًا عند تجاوز ملوحة عجينة التربة المُشبعة (المُدخَلة كإشارة مخصّصة باسم `soil_salinity` بوحدة dS/m) لعتبة تحمّل البطاطس للملوحة. العتبات الافتراضية وفق FAO-29: 1.7 dS/m بداية الضرر (~12% فقد في المحصول لكل dS/m)، وإجهاد حاد فوق 3.8 dS/m. عدّلها حسب الصنف.
description_en: Raises a warning/critical signal when a block's soil saturated-paste ECe (ingested as the custom signal `soil_salinity`, in dS/m) exceeds the potato salinity tolerance threshold. Default thresholds follow FAO-29: 1.7 dS/m onset (~12% yield loss per dS/m), with severe stress above 3.8 dS/m (>25% expected yield loss). Tune per cultivar.

evidence.notes: ECe 1.7 dS/m threshold and 12%/dS/m slope are the canonical FAO-29 (Maas–Hoffman 1977) potato values — robust but conservative: modern cultivars can reach ECe90 of 4–5 dS/m, and arid drip systems have shown steeper slopes (Tunisia, Spunta: 34–54%/dS/m). No Egypt-specific primary threshold was found, so Egypt applicability is inherited from arid/Mediterranean data. ECe ≈ 1.5 × ECw under typical 15–20% leaching. A 5.9%/dS/m slope sometimes cited was checked and rejected. Tune thresholds per cultivar via parameters.

tree_yaml:
# potato_soil_salinity_v1 — flag salinity stress on potato from a soil
# ECe (saturated-paste extract electrical conductivity) custom signal.
#
# Point-in-time threshold rule (KB content track, post-P1). Reads a
# tenant-defined custom signal coded `soil_salinity` carrying ECe in
# dS/m. The tree stays dormant (resolves to no_action) until such a
# signal is ingested for the block — the correct fail-safe behaviour.
#
# Thresholds are the canonical FAO-29 / Maas-Hoffman potato values
# (ECe threshold 1.7 dS/m, ~12% yield loss per dS/m above it; 90/75/50%
# relative yield at ECe 2.5 / 3.8 / 5.9). They are deliberately
# conservative for modern cultivars (whose ECe90 can reach 4–5) and can
# be loosened per tenant via the parameters below.

code: potato_soil_salinity_v1
name_en: Potato — soil salinity stress
name_ar: البطاطس — إجهاد ملوحة التربة
description_en: >-
  Raises a warning/critical signal when a block's soil saturated-paste
  ECe (ingested as the custom signal `soil_salinity`, in dS/m) exceeds
  the potato salinity tolerance threshold. Default thresholds follow
  FAO-29: 1.7 dS/m onset (~12% yield loss per dS/m), with severe stress
  above 3.8 dS/m (>25% expected yield loss). Tune per cultivar.
description_ar: >-
  يُطلق تنبيهًا تحذيريًا/حرجًا عند تجاوز ملوحة عجينة التربة المُشبعة

  البطاطس للملوحة. العتبات الافتراضية وفق FAO-29: 1.7 dS/m بداية الضرر
  (~12% فقد في المحصول لكل dS/m)، وإجهاد حاد فوق 3.8 dS/m. عدّلها حسب
  الصنف.

tree_yaml:
# t_anthracnose_mealybug_watch — the two pests the plan tracks all the way
# through fruit development.
#
# Source: tatoo Docs/Mango indices- 28_8/AgriPulse_Mango_Indices_Plan_EN.xlsx,
# Stage B of the four Plan sheets, plus the Stage 0 sanitation line.
#
# Anthracnose and mealybug appear together in the plan because they share a
# carry-over route — both survive in pruning debris and fallen fruit, which is
# why Stage 0's sanitation instruction names them both — and because they
# share a season. Neither is a spray-once problem.
#
# They differ in one way that matters here. Anthracnose is weather-driven and
# the platform models it per block, so a score exists to branch on. Mealybug
# is not: it walks up the trunk from the soil, and no weather model or index
# on this platform sees it. So the mealybug half of this card is a standing
# instruction to look, attached to the anthracnose card that already sends
# someone into the block. One visit, two things checked.
#
# Anthracnose is also the disease that shows up after the customer has paid
# for the fruit. The infection happens in the field during humid weeks and
# stays latent; the lesions appear in the box. A card raised during the humid
# week is the only point where anything can be done.

tree_yaml:
# t_bloom_protection — protect the bloom from powdery mildew without killing
# the insects that are setting the crop.
#
# Source: tatoo Docs/Mango indices- 28_8/AgriPulse_Mango_Indices_Plan_EN.xlsx,
# Stage A of the four Plan sheets.
#
# Two instructions in the plan pull against each other in the same two weeks:
#
#   "Begin daily/weekly monitoring for powdery mildew — humid, cool mornings
#    and evenings during flowering are the peak-risk window."
#   "Avoid disruptive sprays during peak bloom to protect pollinating insects
#    — mango is insect-pollinated (flies, bees) and fruit set benefits
#    directly from pollinator activity."
#
# A rule that only knew the first would spray through peak bloom and cost more
# fruit than the mildew would have. A rule that only knew the second would
# watch the bloom rot. The plan resolves it in one line — "time application to
# avoid the peak pollinator-activity hours" — and that timing instruction is
# the whole point of this tree, so it is on the card and not buried in a note.
#
# The risk score comes from the platform's weather-driven powdery mildew
# model, which is already computed per block. This tree adds the bloom stage
# and the pollinator constraint on top of it.

code: t_bloom_protection
name_en: T_BLOOM — powdery mildew during flowering, timed around the pollinators
name_ar: T_BLOOM — البياض الدقيقي أثناء التزهير مع مراعاة الملقّحات
description_en: >-
  Runs while the block is flowering. Reads the weather-driven powdery mildew
  risk and, when it is high enough to act on, gives a sulfur treatment that is
  explicitly timed away from peak pollinator hours. Mango is insect
  pollinated, so a spray at the wrong hour costs more fruit than the disease
  it prevents.
description_ar: >-
  يعمل أثناء تزهير القطعة. يقرأ خطر البياض الدقيقي المحسوب من الطقس، وعند
  ارتفاعه بما يكفي للتصرف يعطي معالجة كبريتية موقوتة صراحةً بعيدًا عن ساعات
  نشاط الملقّحات. تلقيح المانجو حشري، فرشّ في الساعة الخطأ يكلّف من الثمار
  أكثر مما يمنعه المرض.

citations.title: AgriPulse — Mango Indices & Agriculture Plan (English), Index Definitions + the three stage value sheets, 10 m column

evidence.notes: Thresholds are the actionable edge of each size's 10 m band in the AgriPulse mango index guide. The guide states its own limit plainly: no published study measures these indices for these nine mango varieties, and field ground-truthing is recommended before the ranges drive a decision. Every bound is therefore a tunable parameter, and small-tree results carry lower confidence because the guide grades every small-tree cell Low. BSI is the one index here that measures the ground rather than the tree, so it separates a thinning canopy from a lost tree in a way none of the greenness indices can.

tree_yaml:
# t_bsi_ground_cover — BSI against the mango index guide's band for the
# block's recorded tree size.
#
# Source: tatoo Docs/Mango indices- 28_8/AgriPulse_Mango_Indices_Plan_EN.xlsx,
# 10 m column of the three stage value sheets.
#
# Size is the axis that matters. Of the workbook's 72 index x size x
# productivity combinations, 64 hold the same range in all three stage
# sheets, so this tree takes no stage input; only CWSI and SMI genuinely
# move, and they move because irrigation is cut on purpose before harvest.
#
# BSI is the one index here that measures the ground rather than the tree,
# so it separates a thinning canopy from a lost tree in a way none of the
# greenness indices can.

code: t_bsi_ground_cover
name_en: T_BSI — more bare ground than the band for this tree size
name_ar: T_BSI — تربة عارية أكثر من نطاق حجم الشجرة
description_en: >-
  Checks how much bare ground shows between the trees. A high value means
  small or widely spaced trees; a low value means the ground is well
  covered by canopy. Branches on the block's recorded Tree size and
  compares BSI against the band the guide gives for that size. Opens one
  card when the reading is above the band. Needs the Tree size attribute
  to be set on the crop assignment.
description_ar: >-
  يفحص كم من الأرض العارية يظهر بين الأشجار. القيمة المرتفعة تعني أشجارًا
  صغيرة أو متباعدة، والمنخفضة تعني تغطية جيدة بالمجموع. يتفرّع على حجم
  الشجرة المسجّل للقطعة ويقارن BSI بالنطاق الذي يعطيه الدليل لهذا الحجم.
  يفتح بطاقة واحدة عندما تكون القراءة فوق النطاق. يحتاج ضبط خاصية حجم
  الشجرة على تخصيص المحصول.

  leaf_out_of_band_small:
    label_en: BSI above the small-tree band
    label_ar: BSI فوق نطاق الشجرة صغيرة
    outcome:
      action_type: scout
      severity: info
      confidence: 0.4
      valid_for_hours: 168
      parameters:
        priority: medium
      text_en: >-
        More bare ground is showing than the guide expects for this tree
        size. Either trees have been lost, or the canopy has thinned
        enough to open the ground up. The guide's small-tree band for BSI
        at 10 m is 0.35 to 0.55. The guide grades every small-tree cell
        Low, so treat this as advisory and confirm on the ground.
      text_ar: >-
        التربة العارية الظاهرة أكثر مما يتوقعه الدليل لهذا الحجم. إما أن
        أشجارًا فُقدت، أو أن المجموع ترقّق حتى انكشفت الأرض. نطاق الدليل
        للشجرة صغيرة في BSI عند 10 م هو من 0.35 إلى 0.55. يصنّف الدليل كل
        خلايا الشجرة الصغيرة بثقة منخفضة، فاعتبرها استرشادية وأكّدها في
        الأرض.
      actions:
        immediate:
          - text_en: >-
              Count missing or dead trees on the ground.
            text_ar: >-
              أحصِ الأشجار المفقودة أو الميتة في الأرض.
        short_term:
          - text_en: >-
              Check whether a cover crop or weed layer was recently
              removed — that raises BSI without any tree changing.
            text_ar: >-
              تحقق مما إذا أُزيل غطاء نباتي أو حشائش مؤخرًا — فذلك يرفع
              BSI دون أن تتغير أي شجرة.
        monitoring:
          - text_en: Re-read BSI on the next clear scene and check it has moved back inside the band.
            text_ar: أعد قراءة BSI في أول مشهد صافٍ وتأكد أنه عاد داخل النطاق.

The guide calls this the most reliable index for irrigation decisions. Branches on the block's recorded Tree size and compares CWSI against the band the guide gives for that size. citations.title: AgriPulse — Mango Indices & Agriculture Plan (English), Index Definitions + the three stage value sheets, 10 m column

evidence.notes: Thresholds are the actionable edge of each size's 10 m band in the AgriPulse mango index guide. The guide states its own limit plainly: no published study measures these indices for these nine mango varieties, and field ground-truthing is recommended before the ranges drive a decision. Every bound is therefore a tunable parameter, and small-tree results carry lower confidence because the guide grades every small-tree cell Low. Guarded against a saturated reading. CWSI is computed against a fixed dry-canopy constant, and Egyptian summer land-surface temperature over sparse canopy on sand pushes past it, so the value clips to exactly 1.0 and stops carrying information. On Mango Republic 2,959 thermal rows average 0.995. Any reading at or above the saturation guard returns a data-quality leaf, not an irrigation card.

tree_yaml:
# t_cwsi_irrigation_stress — CWSI against the mango index guide's band for the
# block's recorded tree size.
#
# Source: tatoo Docs/Mango indices- 28_8/AgriPulse_Mango_Indices_Plan_EN.xlsx,
# 10 m column of the three stage value sheets.
#
# Size is the axis that matters. Of the workbook's 72 index x size x
# productivity combinations, 64 hold the same range in all three stage
# sheets, so this tree takes no stage input; only CWSI and SMI genuinely
# move, and they move because irrigation is cut on purpose before harvest.
#
# Guarded against a saturated reading.
# CWSI is computed against a fixed dry-canopy constant, and Egyptian summer
# land-surface temperature over sparse canopy on sand pushes past it, so the
# value clips to exactly 1.0 and stops carrying information.
# On Mango Republic 2,959 thermal rows average 0.995.
# Any reading at or above the saturation guard returns a data-quality leaf,
# not an irrigation card.

code: t_cwsi_irrigation_stress
name_en: T_CWSI — irrigation stress above the band for this tree size (thermal)
name_ar: T_CWSI — إجهاد الريّ فوق نطاق حجم الشجرة (حراري)
description_en: >-
  Checks the tree's own canopy temperature against the air, not its
  colour. A well-watered tree cools itself; a thirsty one heats up. The
  guide calls this the most reliable index for irrigation decisions.
  Branches on the block's recorded Tree size and compares CWSI against the
  band the guide gives for that size. Opens one card when the reading is
  above the band. Needs the Tree size attribute to be set on the crop
  assignment.
description_ar: >-
  يفحص حرارة مجموع الشجرة نفسها مقابل الهواء، لا لونها. الشجرة المروية
  جيدًا تبرّد نفسها، والعطشى تسخن. يسميه الدليل أوثق مؤشر لقرارات الريّ.
  يتفرّع على حجم الشجرة المسجّل للقطعة ويقارن CWSI بالنطاق الذي يعطيه
  الدليل لهذا الحجم. يفتح بطاقة واحدة عندما تكون القراءة فوق النطاق. يحتاج
  ضبط خاصية حجم الشجرة على تخصيص المحصول.

evidence:
  confidence: medium
  notes: >-
    Thresholds are the actionable edge of each size's 10 m band in the
    AgriPulse mango index guide. The guide states its own limit plainly:
    no published study measures these indices for these nine mango
    varieties, and field ground-truthing is recommended before the ranges
    drive a decision. Every bound is therefore a tunable parameter, and
    small-tree results carry lower confidence because the guide grades
    every small-tree cell Low. Guarded against a saturated reading. CWSI
    is computed against a fixed dry-canopy constant, and Egyptian summer
    land-surface temperature over sparse canopy on sand pushes past it, so
    the value clips to exactly 1.0 and stops carrying information. On
    Mango Republic 2,959 thermal rows average 0.995. Any reading at or
    above the saturation guard returns a data-quality leaf, not an
    irrigation card.
  citations:
    - source_type: remote_sensing
      title: >-
        AgriPulse — Mango Indices & Agriculture Plan (English), Index
        Definitions + the three stage value sheets, 10 m column
      url: https://agripulse.cloud/docs/mango-index-guide
      year: 2026

description_ar: يعمل فقط على القطع المثمرة داخل نافذة النضج. يفحص هل انخفضت رطوبة التربة فعلًا إلى النطاق المخفّض الذي يُفترض أن ينتجه الريّ الناقص قبل الحصاد. يبلّغ بثلاث نتائج: التخفيض مؤكد، أو التخفيض لم يحدث، أو التخفيض تجاوز المقصود وصار يكلّف حجم الثمرة. يحتاج خاصية الإثمار هذا الموسم ومرحلة نمو القطعة.
description_en: Runs only on bearing blocks inside the maturity window. Checks whether soil moisture has actually fallen into the reduced band that pre-harvest deficit irrigation is meant to produce. Reports three outcomes: the cut is confirmed, the cut has not happened, or the cut has gone deeper than intended and is now costing fruit size. Needs the Bearing this season attribute and the block's growth stage.

evidence.notes: The practice is well documented; the numbers used to detect it are not. Pre-harvest deficit irrigation to raise soluble solids is standard horticulture, and the mango index guide's own Stage C plan calls for it. The SMI bands that detect it are the weakest cells in the guide, Medium-Low across the board, and the guide says there is no single standardized SMI formula. Treat a missing-cut card as a prompt to ask the irrigation manager, not as a measurement of what they did.

outcome.text_ar: انخفضت رطوبة التربة إلى النطاق المخفّض الذي يعطيه الدليل لهذا الحجم في نافذة العجز قبل الحصاد، ولم تتجاوزه. الممارسة تعمل كما هو مقصود. لاحظ أن بطاقات الماء من T_SMI و T_NDMI على هذه القطعة متوقعة في هذه النافذة وليست أعطالًا.

short_term.text_en: Confirm this block is on the same irrigation shift as the rest of its harvest group; a shared valve overrides a per-block plan.

outcome.text_ar: هذه القطعة مثمرة وداخل نافذة النضج، وهي الوقت الذي تطلب فيه الخطة خفض الريّ ليركّز الثمر سكرياته. ما زالت رطوبة التربة تقرأ عند مستوى الريّ الكامل، فإما أن التخفيض لم يبدأ أو أن هذه القطعة فاتت. الثمرة من قطعة مروية بالكامل أقل نكهة.
outcome.text_en: This block is bearing and inside its maturity window, which is when the plan calls for irrigation to be reduced so the fruit concentrates its sugars. Soil moisture is still reading at the fully watered level, so either the cut has not started or this block was missed. Fruit harvested from a fully watered block eats flatter.

outcome.text_en: Pre-harvest deficit irrigation only applies to a block that is carrying fruit and approaching harvest. This block is either resting this season or is at an earlier stage.

immediate.text_ar: أعد ريًّا خفيفًا لهذه القطعة الآن.

monitoring.text_ar: أعد قراءة رطوبة التربة في المشهد التالي وأبقها داخل النطاق المخفّض لا تحته.
monitoring.text_en: Re-read soil moisture on the next scene and hold it inside the reduced band, not below it.

short_term.text_ar: تحقق هل المجموعة كلها مفرطة في الخفض أم هذه القطعة وحدها — قطعة واحدة تشير إلى محبس، والمجموعة تشير إلى الخطة.
short_term.text_en: Check whether the whole harvest group is over-cut or only this block — one block alone points at a valve, the group at the plan.

outcome.text_ar: انخفضت رطوبة التربة دون النطاق المخفّض الذي يعطيه الدليل لهذا الحجم في نافذة العجز. الهدف من الريّ الناقص إجهاد الشجرة بالقدر الكافي لتركيز السكريات فقط؛ وبعد ذلك يتوقف عن زيادة الحلاوة ويبدأ في خصم حجم الثمرة، وفي أسبوع حار يسقطها.
outcome.text_en: Soil moisture has fallen below the reduced band the guide gives for this tree size during the deficit window. Deficit irrigation is meant to stress the tree just enough to concentrate sugars; past that point it stops adding sweetness and starts taking away fruit size, and on a hot week it drops fruit outright.

tree_yaml:
# t_deficit_irrigation_verify — the pre-harvest water cut is a plan; did it
# actually happen, and did it go too far?
#
# Source: tatoo Docs/Mango indices- 28_8/AgriPulse_Mango_Indices_Plan_EN.xlsx,
# Stage C of the four Plan sheets, and the maturity-stage CWSI/SMI rows of the
# value sheets.
#
# This is the only tree in the catalogue that runs the check backwards. Every
# other rule looks for an unwanted reading. This one looks for a WANTED one
# and complains when it is missing.
#
# The plan sheets are explicit: "Begin gradually reducing irrigation (deficit
# irrigation) ahead of harvest to concentrate fruit sugars and improve eating
# quality — this is the same practice reflected in the elevated CWSI/SMI
# ranges for productive Big trees in this phase." That sentence is why 8 of
# the workbook's 72 index x size x productivity combinations change between
# stage sheets while the other 64 hold still. The change is not seasonal
# drift; it is a management decision showing up in the imagery.
#
# So a bearing block in its maturity window that still reads fully watered has
# either skipped the practice or is being irrigated by someone who did not get
# the message, and the fruit will carry less sugar for it. A block that has
# gone well past the reduced band has overshot, and deficit irrigation that
# goes too deep costs fruit size instead of buying sugar.
#
# CWSI would be the better instrument here and the guide says so. It is not
# usable on this platform yet: the value is clipped at its ceiling across
# production, so this tree reads soil moisture and says plainly when the
# thermal half is unavailable.
